title: TEMPER SKIN
description: A brushed steel skin carries moving heat reservoirs, conduction and persistent oxide temper. Touching cold metal heats it; touching a sufficiently hot zone quenches it. The same gesture therefore has opposite consequences depending on material state.

visual_finish.composition: overlapping thermal basins form an asymmetric diagonal across a dark steel plate, with cooler negative space preserved around the perimeter
visual_finish.material_model: brushed steel with physically motivated heat temper colours, oxide memory, gradient-derived buckling and directional grain
